name: Shorter onboarding checklist
objective: Help new users reach their first project sooner
change: Replaced the seven-step setup with a guided three-step checklist
learning: A focused first action reduced setup friction; advanced options work better after activation.

name: Annual-plan checkout prompt
change: Added an annual-plan prompt before payment
learning: Presenting a long commitment before value is experienced created hesitation for new users.

name: Team invite reminder
objective: Increase collaboration in the first week
change: Sent an in-app reminder to invite a teammate on day three
learning: The reminder was noticed, but the audience was too small to separate timing from product-fit effects.
